utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hey Opal — I’m still waiting on the final repair-drive plan, but I’m happy to help once Vik’s got it sorted.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Noah — I’m just waiting on Vik’s final details too, and once I have them I’ll send over the location and hours so you can help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good, Opal — I’ll keep an eye out for your update and help spread the word once the location and hours come through.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can help with lifting, simple repairs, organizing supplies, or running errands. I’m usually free evenings after 5 or this Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s perfect, Sam — I’ll let folks know you’re available for lifting, repairs, supplies, or errands after 5 and Saturday morning. Thanks for jumping in!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help, Quinn — just point me where I’m needed, and I’ll be there after 5 or Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I can start sorting the most urgent items now, and I’ll bring the packing tape too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh perfect, Leo — that’ll help a ton. If you can, just keep an eye out for a couple more day-of helpers too, and I’ll keep nudging folks about the 9:30 to 11:30 window.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll watch for a couple more helpers and keep sorting the urgent items. See you in the 9:30 to 11:30 window.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an eye out while I’m out and let you know if I hear anything helpful for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Ira — that’d be really helpful. I’ve moved the repair drive to Sunday at the community center, so if you hear of any needs or updates, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Got it, Rosa — I’ll keep an ear out and pass along anything useful while I’m running errands.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, the repair drive. Just point me at the next job when you’ve got it, and I’ll get right on it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — send me the drive list, and I’ll point you to the next job. What needs fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m a bit foggy on the list, Mina — could you send me the drive details again? Then I’ll jump on the first repair right away.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Kira — I’m usually the last to hear about these things, so I appreciate the update. If anything new comes up with the repair drive, just let me know when you can.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm exactly what’s still needed for the repair drive? I want to make sure I’ve got it right.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m not sure I have the full list, honestly — I’m usually hearing it secondhand. If you’ve got the latest, send it along and I’ll keep an eye out for anything else.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Eli — I’ve got the repair drive details lined up, and I’ll keep you posted if anything changes. If you can help spread the word, that’d be a big help too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Absolutely — I’ll help spread the word and keep the routine going. Just send me any updates, and I’ll pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Eli — that’s a huge help. I’ll send updates as soon as anything changes, and I appreciate you helping keep things steady.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand or a tool for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need most.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Gus — I’ll keep it simple: send the latest list and timing, and I’ll skim it to see what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it — send me the latest list and timing, and I’ll keep it handy so I’m ready to help with whatever’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Absolutely—send me the details and I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Dane — I really appreciate that. The sweet spot is 9:30 to 11:30, since it works around school drop-off and pickup.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — 9:30 to 11:30 works. I’ll pass that along with the location so folks know where to go.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Hana — I’ll check the list and let you know what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Rey — that helps. When you’ve checked it, could you send me the list and let me know your availability too?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Of course — I’ll check the list and send it over, along with when I’m free.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, I’ll send that rundown tonight so we’ve got everything in one place. Thanks — see you Saturday at 10.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Pia — I’ll check the set-aside supplies and send the updated list with exactly what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Perfect, thanks, Cleo — that should help us avoid any last-minute scrambling. If anything changes, just send it over and I’ll update the checklist.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: We’re still sorting the repair drive details, Mara, but I’ll repeat the plan as soon as it’s set and keep Noah in the loop too.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Vik — that helps. Just let me know the plan when it’s set, and I’ll keep the sorting table ready.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll pass along the final plan to you and Noah as soon as it’s locked in. Thanks for keeping the sorting table ready.
